purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software - system management information settings screen (W01). Manages medical institution information, classification codes, period settings, printer assignments, and various system parameters for Japanese medical billing.
purpose.summary: This program implements the system management information settings screen (ORCGW01) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles display and editing of various system configuration items including medical institution info, diagnosis settings, receipt printing parameters, and classification codes. It is a long-lived production program with an extensive revision history spanning 2000-2015.

notable_features: Long revision history (2000-2015) with named developers
OCCURS tables for period/classification code management
WRK-MCP-WIDGET field suggesting GTK/MCP GUI integration
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
126 PERFORM statements, 30 GOTO statements indicating complex flow
